notes.title: Elden 2021 Update Log #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Onerat Dylan here, developer of Elden of the Forgotten. [/h2]

Creating a game is a hard thing to do, let alone making one solo. I personally burnt out during the development cycle and didn't deliver the product I was hoping to create.  

I’ve seen the Lets Plays and read the reviews and I understand your misgivings with the current game.

To that end, I've been working on what at this point can only be described as an overhaul. Every element of the game is getting the attention it deserves. 

Here I've listed some of the major changes I've implemented so far. Note that this is in no way a complete change log for the Elden Path of the Forgotten overhaul.

Iv been slack with posting development updates to Steam, but with this announcement that is something I plan on changing. Keep an eye out for future announcements and forum posts detailing the coming overhauled version of Elden: Path of the Forgotten.

If you have any suggestions or feedback with this overhaul in mind, I'm always happy to listen. You easily reach me at [url=discord.gg/oneratgames.]discord.gg/oneratgames.[/url]

notes.title: The Enemy Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Wanderer,[/h1]

We’re pleased you found us in these blasted lands and broken times. 
[u][i]I have come to offer you a gift. 
[/i][/u]A parcel of data so small it is almost imperceptible, but more powerful than you can imagine. Join us once more and test your blade against the fast, smarter horrors that stand between you and your goal. Face new foes and threats beyond your imagining. 

[b]Good luck, Wanderer.[/b] 

[h3]Announcement Content:
[/h3]

[list]
[*] New boss (The Forsaken Twins).
[*] New enemy (Rubble Caster).
[*] Level improvements.
[*] Adjusted final region.
[*] FPS improvements.
[*] Layering issues with 3rd boss.
[*] The 1st boss uses more of its attacks and movement.
[*] Fixes to event triggering in the desert region.
[*] Rebinding improvements.
[/list]

[h3]Improved enemy behaviour:
[/h3]
	          [list]
[*] Navigate around objects in the world.
[*] 	          Return to idle when not moving in direction.
[*] 	          More aggressively attack.
[*] 	          Ranged enemies trigger distance.
[/list]

notes.title: 🌳Yggdrasill has a new hope!🌳 (0.2.16)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129069/390d67d270e6023bc1f1c9dee8e9eef7d7dff537.gif[/img]

[h1][b]The tree of life, 🌳Yggdrasill🌳 has opened the doors to the Neverinth once more and summoned another fearless heroine to its halls. [/b][/h1]
She too faces the task of returning the universe to balance and restoring Valhalla to its former glory. 
Along with her trusted katana, she brings a unique set of abilities adding a touch of elegance and poise to Neverinth’s brutal combat. 
In addition, two new weapons (Freeze Bomb and Energy Mead) and three more jewels will be available in her path to the sacred halls reconquest.

[h1]Check out all the new updates![/h1]
[olist] 
[*]Added：New character – Proud Aspirant 
[*]Added：New weapon Type – Katana 
[*]Added：New skill for the Cultist Mentor boss 
[*]Added：2 New Items 
[*]Added：3 New Jewelry 
[*]Added：1 New Grace 
[*]Added：Customized control settings 
[*]Added：UI prompts will change with different controller/keyboard 
[*]Added：BGM volume control. Sound Effect control  
[*]Added：Motion blur switch 
[*]Added：Japanese localization  
[*]Added：Totem tutorial 
[*]Adjustment：UX adjustment of Totem system (especially with mouse & keyboard) 
[*]Adjustment：Mouse camera control improvements. System- Camera speed ​​unit refinement 
[*]Adjustment：Value adjustment of Bosses – Gram. Cultist Mentor 
[*]Adjustment：Broaden the room of first level (Broaden some part of first level) 
[*]Bug fix：Enemies stop sometimes after we hit them 
[*] Character control improvements 
[/olist] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Totem Power[/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Garm Totem：Attack stamina consumption -70% -> -50%、Life Debt restoration with attack +35% -> +25% 
[/list] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Jewelry ability [/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Power of Will：When consuming stamina, increase damage % based on current stamina divided by 12 -> 10. 
[*]Earring of Exertion：Damage increases by 1% for every 5 -> 3 stamina points consumed 
[*]Frostbitten Necklace：Shield +180 -> +120. Increases damage taken by 30% -> 35% but freezes the nearby attacker. 
[*]Earring of Adrenaline：Shield +150 -> +70. Physical defense +2 -> +10 
[*]Earring of Proficiency：Shield +400 -> +250  
[*]Earring of Exchange：Shield +280 -> +200. When shielded, every 500 -> 300 Essence possessed by the character will increase damage by 1% 
[*]Alchemist's Ring：Shield +200 -> +150 
[/list]
